title: Subqueries with EXISTS / IN
description: Find all customers who have placed an order with a total greater than $200. Use both IN and EXISTS approaches (separate queries, but for verification just provide one).
hints: IN: WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE total > 200)
EXISTS: WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE customer_id = c.customer_id AND total > 200)
EXISTS is usually faster for large datasets
